newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: G10 sees growth continuing in N.America, U.K..
newsitem.headline: G10 sees growth continuing in N.America, U.K..

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said Group of 10 (G10) central bank governors believed that economic growth was continuing in North America and the United Kingdom.
Tietmeyer said that growth in Japan appeared to be on a self-sustaining path.

In continental Europe, Tietmeyer said there was some improvement but with the situation varying from country to country. He did not specify which countries were faring better or which were showing slower growth.
"North America and the U.K. are already very much advanced in this cycle, and growth is continuing," Tietmeyer said.
Tietmeyer was speaking after a monthly meeting of G10 central bankers at the Bank for International Settlements here, of which he is chairman.
"In Japan, prospects are that growth will come more and more on a self-sustainable growth path," he said.
"In continental Europe, there is some improvement in some countries especially," Tietmeyer said, adding that the situation was different from country to country.
Tietmeyer added that structural unemployment was the key policy challenge for continental European economies.
"All countries are trying to overcome or to reduce unemployment but the problem is that most of it is structural," Tietmeyer said about continental Europe.
Tietmeyer said unemployment must be addressed in an "appropriate way" but did not elaborate.
